data.body: GAP NOTE: _PLUGIN_ROOT is module-level. Changing it to prefer CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT env var means the env var is only read at module import time (not per-call). This is correct for production (CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT is set before import). For tests: tests must set CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT before importing dispatch, OR dispatch must be re-imported after setting env var, OR _AGENTS_DIR must be computed as a function rather than module-level constant. Recommendation: keep _PLUGIN_ROOT and _AGENTS_DIR as module-level constants (set at import time) — document this in the code. Tests that patch CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT must use 'importlib.reload(dispatch_module)' after setting env var, or use a fixture that patches _AGENTS_DIR directly (via monkeypatch.setattr(dispatch_module, '_AGENTS_DIR', tmp_path/'agents')). The RED test in Task A must use the direct _AGENTS_DIR patch approach to work cleanly with lru_cache. Update Task A's test approach accordingly.
